question: compare average daily attendance rate per centre across the two years, one row each
gold_sql: WITH combined AS (SELECT "Centre" AS centre, 2023 AS year, "Avg Daily Present" / "Enrolled Kids" * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2023 UNION ALL SELECT centre_name AS centre, 2024 AS year, average_attendance / enrolment * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2024) SELECT centre, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) AS avg_rate_2023, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN rate END) AS avg_rate_2024 FROM combined GROUP BY centre ORDER BY centre
sql_duckdb: WITH rates_2023 AS (SELECT "Centre" AS centre, "Month" AS month, "Avg Daily Present" AS present, "Enrolled Kids" AS enrolled FROM "attendance_2023"), rates_2024 AS (SELECT "centre_name" AS centre, "month" AS month, "average_attendance" AS present, "enrolment" AS enrolled FROM "attendance_2024"), combined AS (SELECT * FROM rates_2023 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM rates_2024), rates AS (SELECT centre, month, present, enrolled, CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN (present * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(enrolled, 0), 0)) ELSE (present * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(enrolled, 0), 0)) END AS rate FROM combined CROSS JOIN (SELECT 2023 AS year UNION ALL SELECT 2024) AS years) SELECT r1.centre, r1.month, r1.rate AS rate_2023, r2.rate AS rate_2024 FROM rates AS r1 JOIN rates AS r2 ON r1.centre = r2.centre AND r1.month = r2.month WHERE r1.year = 2023 AND r2.year = 2024 ORDER BY r1.centre NULLS FIRST, r1.month NULLS FIRST
